title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
O que você fará:

Projetar e desenvolver arquiteturas de dados que suportem indicadores estratégicos, metas e engajamento.

Construir e automatizar pipelines ETL/ELT integrando sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados analíticos (Star Schema e Snowflake).

Escrever e otimizar SQL avançado (CTEs, funções de janela, ajuste de desempenho).

Implementar processamento e automação de dados usando Python.

Construir e manter plataformas de dados baseadas em nuvem na AWS

Trabalhar com Amazon S3, Redshift e/ou Athena para dar suporte ao armazenamento e análise de dados

Aplicar a qualidade, governança e linhagem dos dados em todos os conjuntos de dados

Colaborar com as partes interessadas do negócio para traduzir as necessidades do negócio em conjuntos de dados analíticos

Dar suporte a ferramentas de BI e análise, como Power BI, Tableau e Looker

Garantir a conformidade com os requisitos regulatórios e de governança em ambientes bancários e de fintech

Requisitos Mandatários:

Sólida experiência como engenheiro de dados.

Solida experiencia com SQL (CTEs, funções de janela, otimização de desempenho).

Experiência com modelagem analítica de dados.

Experiência prática na construção e automação de pipelines ETL/ELT.

Fortes habilidades em Python para processamento de dados e automação.

Sólida experiência com arquiteturas de dados em nuvem na AWS.

Experiência prática com Amazon S3 e Redshift e/ou Athena.

Experiência na integração de sistemas transacionais e analíticos.

Sólida experiência em armazenamento de dados e data lakes.

Experiência no uso do Git para controle de versão de código.

Sólido conhecimento de qualidade, governança e linhagem de dados.

Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em conjuntos de dados analíticos confiáveis.

Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker).

Experiência anterior em ambientes regulamentados (bancos, fintechs, LGPD).

Diferenciais:

Experiência com dbt.

Uso de ferramentas de orquestração, como Airflow, Prefect ou Dagster.

Conhecimento de AWS Glue. Experiencia com IA.

Familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform).

Conhecimento de arquiteturas Lakehouse ou Data Mesh.

Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

title: Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.


Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor
description:
Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;

title: Senior Shopify Marketing Designer
description:
Company Description

Creative Forge LLC partners with Shopify health and wellness brands to help them scale their businesses to over $1 million per month in revenue. By leveraging full funnel optimization, including static ads, pre-sale pages, product pages, and email campaigns, the company effectively lowers customer acquisition costs (CAC) while improving conversion rates (CVR). Our focus is on delivering strong results and impactful growth for our clients in a fast-paced, innovative environment.


Role Description

This is a full-time, fully remote role for a Senior Shopify Marketing Designer at Creative Forge, a performance-focused creative agency that partners with Shopify-based health and wellness brands to scale revenue through high-converting static ads, pre-sale pages, product pages, and email flows. The Senior Shopify Marketing Designer will design and optimize conversion-driven Shopify experiences across the full funnel, with a strong focus on CRO, e-commerce UX, and direct-response marketing principles. Responsibilities include translating strategy and copy into high-performing designs, iterating on existing pages based on performance insights, and collaborating closely with copywriters, marketers, and developers to ensure designs are conversion-optimized, build-ready, and consistent across brand systems. This role is highly execution-focused and requires someone who can move quickly within a defined scope while maintaining a high bar for visual quality, usability, and measurable performance outcomes.


Qualifications

Primary Job Duties:

  • Shopify website and landing pages creation, design and optimization
  • Email campaigns & blog visuals
  • Brand guideline creation and conceptualization
  • Evolve and maintain a consistent visual language across platforms

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Senior-level UX/UI design experience (5+ years preferred)
  • Strong experience designing Shopify websites
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce UX, CRO principles, and user behavior
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component systems, styles, auto-layout, and clean file organization
  • Familiarity with Canva and ability to translate designs into a professional design system
  • Experience working closely with developers and preparing designs for handoff
  • Strong attention to detail, visual polish, and usability best practices
  • Ability to work efficiently on a defined scope without unnecessary over-engineering
  • Excellent English — we collaborate a lot
  • Based between GMT-5 and GMT+2
  • Full-time availability 


The Interview Process:

1️⃣ Intro conversation with CEO

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Systems Engineer (Fully Remote)


We’re looking for a Systems Engineer to help build, automate, and support development and test environments across a large-scale platform. You’ll play a key role in designing, deploying, and optimising cloud and on-prem environments that support critical applications from build through to production support.


What you’ll do

  • Build and manage development & test environments across on-prem and AWS platforms
  • Automate infrastructure and platform tasks using Python , Ansible , and Flux
  • Deploy and support applications on Kubernetes (including Helm-based deployments)
  • Ensure seamless system integration, reliability, performance, and security
  • Monitor platforms and applications, implementing automated testing and health checks
  • Troubleshoot complex platform and deployment issues
  • Collaborate closely with development and operations teams


What you’ll bring

  • Strong automation and scripting experience with Python
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerised platforms
  • Experience deploying applications using Helm
  • Understanding of JSON and its relationship to YANG
  • Solid grasp of cyber security principles and compliance
  • Foundational networking knowledge
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills


Nice to have

  • Experience with tools/technologies such as Kafka, Elastic stack, Redis, MongoDB, Postgres
  • AWS services including EKS, Lambda, Cognito, API Gateway
  • Network and infrastructure tooling (NetBox, Juniper, Cisco, MinIO)
  • Testing frameworks such as Behave or Robot Framework


Location: Fully Remote

Role type: Contract


If you enjoy building reliable platforms through automation and working across modern cloud and container technologies, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Portuguese Language Expert - Annotator/Evaluator (LLM)| Upto $8/hr Hourly
description:
About the job


We are an HR company specializing in the management of AI model training talent worldwide. We are currently on behalf of a leading global AI company, confidentially looking for an Portuguese Language Expert - Annotator/Evaluator (LLM).


Type : Contract

Compensation : $3–$8/hour

Location : Remote

Commitment : 20+ hours/week


Role Responsibilities

  • Understand user tasks or questions (prompt) and evaluate model outputs according to defined standards, conducting structured data annotation
  • Classify model responses and assess whether they meet user needs
  • Follow the provided training, workflows, and rules to complete double-blind evaluations and quality checks
  • Record issues discovered and provide feedback on questions or uncertainties encountered during evaluation
  • Work independently and asynchronously with a flexible schedule to meet deadlines.

Qualifications Must-Have

  • Native or fluent proficiency in Portuguese and English .
  • Strong reading comprehension and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow detailed guidelines and deliver high-quality work independently.
  • Interest in AI, chatbots, or image recognition models

Preferred

  • Experience with data annotation.

Compensation & Legal

  • Competitive hourly rates, adjusted for geography.
  • Payments are issued monthly via Deel .
  • Classified as an independent contractor.

Application Process

  • Submit your resume to express interest.
  • Complete a short information form below
  • Complete a brief qualification task if requested (sent via email after we receive your application)
  • Follow up within a few days with the next steps.

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Basis Consultant who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Technical

Strong knowledge of IT Service Management, SAP Basis and SAP Applications

Hands-on experience with SAP Basis activities, SAP release version upgrades and infrastructure updates for cloud customers

Working experience with SAP HEC, SAP S/4HANA or any other cloud solution.

Hands-on experience with infrastructure operations, network, interfaces and Load Balancer topics related to SAP landscape management (TLO)

Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to form the solution/designing the mechanism for end to end solutioning

Hands on experience in Migration (onpremise to Cloud/Cross cloud/Cross DC's)


Soft Skills

Excellent customer focus / Networking / Relationship Building /Results-driven / Self-organized / Decision making

Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

Understanding of escalation handling and procedures with customers while proactively working with internal teams towards arriving at a resolution

Experience in working with cross-cultural and cross-functional teams or individuals

Proficiency in English (Written and verbal)

Cloud architecture and IT technical infrastructure know-how

Knowledge of/certification in one of Azure, AWS or GCP fundamentals

Experience with Migration, Upgrade projects esp. on S/4H Cloud

Knowledge of Project Management Fundamentals, ITIL, Lean Fundamentals is a plus

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Especialista em Análise de Dados
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Alinhar a estratégia de dados aos objetivos do negócio, priorizando iniciativas de alto impacto e geração de valor.
  • Liderar projetos analíticos complexos, com desenvolvimento de modelos avançados e visualizações analíticas de alto nível.
  • Atuar como referência técnica na área de dados, promovendo boas práticas e capacitando usuários para garantir autonomia analítica e tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas, com experiência profissional entre 5 e 7 anos.
  • Sólida atuação em ambientes Cloud, pipelines de ETL complexos e otimização de consultas em SQL e Python, com perfil multiplicador de conhecimento.
  • Expertise avançada em ferramentas de BI e evolução de arquiteturas de dados.
  • Forte capacidade de liderança e comunicação, com habilidade para traduzir análises técnicas em insights claros para stakeholders de negócio.


Nossos benefícios:


  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • WellHurb;
  • Auxílio Farmácia;
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);
  • Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem);
  • Bônus Anual


Local de Trabalho: REMOTO

- FastAPI

- Kubernetes

E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Advogado Tributário (Remoto)
description:
Advogado Tributário


Início Imediato / 100% Remoto


Remuneração Inicial entre R$4.000 e R$5.000, a depender da experiência.


Qualificações:


  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em contencioso tributário (judicial e administrativo) em escritório de advocacia;
  • 2 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em consultoria tributária (desejável);
  • Experiência em Big Four (diferencial);
  • Pós-graduação de Direito Tributário (diferencial);


Principais Atividades:


  • Atuar em demandas judiciais e administrativas tributárias e fiscais;
  • Analisar publicações e controlar seus respectivos prazos;
  • Prestar atendimento eficiente aos clientes, garantindo uma comunicação clara e transparente;
  • Realizar pesquisas jurídicas abrangentes para embasar estratégias de defesa;
  • Colaborar com colegas de equipe para desenvolver e implementar estratégias jurídicas eficazes;
  • Atuar na consultoria tributária envolvendo Tributos Diretos e Indiretos;
  • Elaborar respostas a consultas e memorandos sobre temas variados ligados ao Direito Tributário;
  • Avaliar regimes tributários especiais e benefícios fiscais aplicáveis;
  • Planejamento tributário estratégico, incluindo reorganizações societárias.


Sobre o Santos Varella Advocacia


  • O Santos Varella Advocacia é um escritório boutique de advocacia especializado em Direito Tributário, Direito Empresarial e Direito Civil. Com equipe de profissionais qualificados com mais de 15 anos de excelência no mercado, atuamos na consultoria e no contencioso. Nosso diferencial está na vasta experiência de nossos profissionais, cujo histórico abrange setores jurídicos de grandes escritórios e empresas multinacionais.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
About the job


Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time


About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.


  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack


  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background


  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours


How to Apply

Apply here:


  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM
description:
Title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract

Job Specific Responsibilities:

● Have the ability to assist requesters in refining business requirement details to ensure the customers will be receiving functionality requested.

● Gain knowledge of our overall ServiceNow implementation to understand and identify cross platform impacts of changes or enhancements being requested.

● Design, develop, and implement SPM solutions including workflows, catalog items, workspaces, and integrations to meet complex business requirements

● Configure and customize the ServiceNow platform using javascript and ServiceNow APIs to extend capabilities and enhance user experience

● Design and implement workflows to support business needs and increase automation

● Develop and configure integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using integration spokes or custom APIs

● Work within the Agile methodology to develop, build and test alongside other developers to ensure the best product is delivered to requestors in a timely manner

● Work with implementation partners, or internal project teams to Implement new modules as business needs evolve

● Assist with regular ServiceNow version upgrades to ensure we remain compliant and supported by the vendor

Key Skills, Requirements and Competencies:

● Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a relevant technical field

● At least 3+ years experience working with the ServiceNow platform, specifically in the SPM module, and with good familiarity with ITSM, and the general ServiceNow platform

● Strong understanding of ITIL principles and practices

● Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow API web services

● Proven experience with integrating ServiceNow with other applications

● Excellent analytical and problem solving skills

● Effective communication and interpersonal skills

Thanks

Aatmesh

Representante de Vendas – Food Service | Utilidades Profissionais e Domésticas

Chef Line Inox


Sobre a Chef Line

A Chef Line é uma marca e importadora de utilidades domésticas e institucionais, com forte atuação no segmento de food service.

Nosso portfólio inclui utensílios de cozinha para preparo e serviço, cutelaria, opaline, talheres, cubas GN, botijões térmicos, cafeteiras elétricas, panelas aquecedoras, réchauds elétricos e a fogareiro, além de outros produtos profissionais, com certificação Inmetro quando aplicável e garantia.

Desde 2017, fornecemos soluções para cozinhas profissionais em todo o Brasil.

Escritório em Itajaí (SC) e Centro de Distribuição em São José (SC), com entrega nacional.

Atendemos atacados, distribuidores, lojistas, supermercados e canais de marketplace, com portfólio de alto giro.

Contamos com política de parcelamento, frete CIF para diversas regiões, equipe interna dedicada e aplicativo próprio para gestão de pedidos e informações de produto.

Estamos contratando Representantes de Vendas para todos os estados do Brasil.

  • Acompanhar pedidos, pós-venda e relacionamento comercial

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative developers eager to craft innovative products and embrace new technologies. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists who are building next generation of solutions for Risk Management team and Portfolio Managers.


To thrive in our team, you should possess an independent mindset while enjoying a collaborative working environment. We value candidates with full software lifecycle experience, encompassing requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing support.


Responsibilities:

  • Minimum 5 years of backend development experience, preferably within the hedge fund or financial services industry
  • Strong passion for backend architecture and application development, with a commitment to continuous learning and improvement
  • Deep understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, SOLID principles, and design patterns
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, Entity Framework Core
  • Building and optimizing high-load, high-performance, data-driven backend systems
  • Designing and implementing RESTful and SOAP-based web services
  • Experience with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA)


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Databricks Architect
description:
Databricks Architect / Senior Data Engineer (Contract)

Location: Brazil (Remote – supporting US-based clients)

Contract Length: 6 months


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Databricks Architect who remains highly hands-on as a Data Engineer to support data platform design and delivery for US-based clients. This role will focus on building and optimizing modern lakehouse solutions, with strong ownership of architecture decisions while actively contributing to development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evolve Databricks lakehouse solutions , following medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) best practices
  • Act as the technical architect while remaining hands-on in pipeline development , optimization, and troubleshooting
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and SQL
  • Collaborate with US-based stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Optimize performance, cost, and reliability across data workloads
  • Contribute to data modeling, data quality, and governance practices
  • Leverage recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric where appropriate, understanding how it complements or integrates with Databricks-based architectures


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as a Databricks Architect and/or Senior Data Engineer
  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing medallion architecture in production environments
  • Advanced knowledge of Apache Spark , Databricks , and SQL
  • Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines and lakehouse architectures
  • Recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric (hands-on preferred)
  • Ability to balance architecture leadership with hands-on engineering work
  • Strong English language skills and experience working with US-based clients or teams


Nice to Have

  • Experience in consulting or professional services environments
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and cost optimization in cloud platforms
  • Experience working in hybrid Databricks / Fabric ecosystems

We are seeking an experienced Databricks Architect who remains highly hands-on as a Data Engineer to support data platform design and delivery for US-based clients.   • Act as the technical architect while remaining hands-on in pipeline development , optimization, and troubleshooting

  • Strong experience as a Databricks Architect and/or Senior Data Engineer
  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing medallion architecture in production environments

  • Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines and lakehouse architectures
  • Recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric (hands-on preferred)

  • Strong English language skills and experience working with US-based clients or teams


Nice to Have

title: Analista de contabilidade sênior
description:
Descrição da Empresa O Grupo Polaro é um ecossistema de soluções contábeis, fiscais, jurídicas e estratégicas, que atua lado a lado com empresários e profissionais liberais — especialmente da área da saúde — ajudando negócios a crescerem de forma organizada, segura e sustentável.


Valorizamos pessoas que gostam de processos bem feitos, responsabilidade técnica e visão de negócio, indo além da contabilidade operacional.

Esse profissional será responsável por atividades fechamento fiscal e contabil, apuracao do ISS , Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional e todas as obrigacoes acessorias perante a receita federal


Qualificações


  • Conhecimento Contábil e Fiscal: Experiência em reconciliações contábeis, apuração de impostos e entrega de obrigações acessórias.
  • Analítico e Detalhista: Habilidade em análises financeiras, conferência de dados contábeis e comprometimento com precisão.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas: Familiaridade com sistemas ALTERDATA E ACESSORIAS e forte capacidade de trabalho com planilhas como Excel.
  • Precisa ter CRC ativo


Competências Conportamentais

• Organização e atenção aos detalhes

• Responsabilidade e compromisso com prazos

• Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe

• Perfil analítico e visão de melhoria contínua

• Experiência com equipe


Modelo de trabalho

  • Presencial
  • Local: Belém – PA
  • Segunda a Sexta de 8:00 as 18:00 com uma hora de almoço
  • Salário : $5.000 + VA + AJUDA DE CUSTO
  • Conta com a presença de um terapeuta de negocios
  • Acesso a cursos pagos pela Empresa

title: Android Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
Sobre Nós:

A Unlimitail é uma joint venture entre o Grupo Carrefour e o Grupo Publicis, que tem como objetivo atender ao crescente mercado de retail media na Europa e América Latina, desenvolvendo soluções eficazes para as principais necessidades do mercado: vender mais, personalização, oportunidades para as marcas, medição e transparência e presença omnicanal.

A empresa se destaca no mercado hoje graças à sua experiência e tecnologia de publicidade de ponta, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, que unifica recursos onsite e offsite. Além disso, a Unlimitail oferece alcance global e dados de alta qualidade, com mais de 1,5 bilhão de visualizações de página mensais e um banco de dados de mais de 120 milhões de clientes endereçáveis em todo o mundo.



Contexto da Vaga de Emprego:

Você fará parte do Analytics & AI Lab, um squad multifuncional responsável por desenvolver algoritmos avançados e soluções de IA aplicadas a dados de retail media e comércio.

O squad atua como uma unidade de P&D e IA aplicada, construindo algoritmos que são:

  • alimentados por múltiplas fontes internas de dados;
  • expostos por meio de APIs;
  • consumidos por produtos, times de analytics e stakeholders de negócio.

Todo o ecossistema é construído sobre a Google Cloud Platform, com forte integração entre engenharia de dados, analytics engineering e desenvolvimento de IA.



Missão:

Como Senior Data Scientist, sua missão será desenhar, desenvolver e operacionalizar algoritmos de machine learning e IA que gerem valor de negócio em contextos de retail media. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analytics engineers, data engineers e times de produto para transformar dados brutos em soluções preditivas, prescritivas e inteligentes, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e explicabilidade.



Principais Atividades:

Desenvolvimento de IA & Machine Learning

  • Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos de machine learning e algoritmos de IA;
  • Conduzir P&D de algoritmos de IA, da fase exploratória até soluções prontas para produção;
  • Selecionar abordagens de modelagem adequadas (estatísticas, ML, deep learning) conforme o problema de negócio.

Dados & Feature Engineering

  • Consumir dados do BigQuery e de camadas analíticas curadas;
  • Definir e criar features em parceria com os times de analytics e engenharia de dados;
  • Garantir qualidade, relevância e consistência dos dados para modelagem.

Implantação e Integração de Modelos

  • Empacotar modelos e algoritmos para exposição via APIs;
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia para implantação em ambientes produtivos;
  • Monitorar performance dos modelos, drift e necessidades de reentreinamento.

Casos de Uso em Retail Media

  • Desenvolver modelos relacionados a:
  • previsão de demanda;
  • performance de campanhas;
  • atribuição e uplift;
  • tráfego e conversão;
  • segmentação de audiências;
  • Traduzir KPIs de retail media e e-commerce em soluções orientadas por ML.

Colaboração & Trabalho em Squad

  • Atuar em um squad multicultural (Brasil + França), com comunicação diária em inglês;
  • Colaborar com stakeholders de analytics, produto e engenharia;
  • Contribuir com discussões técnicas, documentação e compartilhamento de conhecimento dentro do laboratório.



Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Forte experiência com Python para data science e ML;
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de machine learning (supervisionados, não supervisionados, séries temporais etc.);
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados utilizando BigQuery;
  • Forte base em estatística e desenho experimental;
  • Experiência em expor modelos via APIs ou integrá-los a sistemas em produção.

Google Cloud & Stack de IA

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform;
  • Familiaridade com:
  • Vertex AI;
  • BigQuery ML;
  • Gemini / ferramentas de GenAI (prompting, embeddings, RAG ou similares);
  • Experiência com notebooks e fluxos de experimentação.



Habilidades Profissionais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Habilidade para traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções de data science;
  • Excelente comunicação;
  • Inglês avançado (uso diário obrigatório).



Habilidades Desejadas:

  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou retail media;
  • Experiência com práticas de MLOps (versionamento, monitoramento, reentreinamento);
  • Vivência em AI Labs ou squads de P&D;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de experimentação e testes A/B;
  • Francês será um diferencial.



Perfil Preferencial:

  • Contribuidor individual sênior;
  • Forte autonomia e senso de ownership;
  • Confortável em ambientes exploratórios e com problemas ambíguos;
  • Capacidade de influenciar por meio de expertise técnica, não por hierarquia;
  • Perfil curioso, experimental e orientado a negócio.

description:
Executive Recruiter (Fluent English – C1/C2) | 100% Remote | U.S. Market


Blue Dot BPO connects strategic LATAM talent with mission-critical operations at U.S.-based companies. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an Executive Recruiter to lead high-impact executive hiring processes while working directly with senior leadership teams in the United States.

Build Your International Career

Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remote


At Blue Dot BPO , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performance executive teams at U.S.-based companies. We are looking for a Recruiter Assistant with excellent English communication skills, strong organization, and a proactive mindset to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This is a fully remote role focused on the U.S. market, offering daily exposure to global teams and a clear growth path for those who want to build a career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$4,000
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S.-based recruiting teams

  • Manage calendars and support communication flow between candidates and recruiters

  • Advanced English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication required
  • Highly organized, focused, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS platforms
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments with tight deadlines

  • Headset with microphone and a quiet workspace

title: Salesforce Release Manager with COPADO
description:
Fast Dolphin is an international staffing company with over two decades of experience specializing in recruiting bilingual and multilingual IT experts across the Americas as well as providing payroll and customized staffing solutions. Moreover, we take pride in boosting the careers and dreams of our professionals.


We are currently looking for a Salesforce Release Manager to work in a Remote position for a 6+ month with possible extension job opportunity.


Job Title: Salesforce Release Manager

Location: Remote in LATAM

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 + months with possible extensions

Responsibilities

  • Acts as the liaison between Product Owners and Salesforce development teams
  • Ensures user stories are complete, tested, approved, and ready for release
  • Manages Salesforce deployments and release pipelines using Copado CI/CD
  • Enforces CI/CD best practices and release governance standards
  • Maintains complete, audit-ready technical and release documentation
  • Coordinates testing activities and release approvals
  • Plans and executes release cycles with a focus on quality and stability
  • Supports system maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting
  • Ensures scalability, compliance, and performance of Salesforce environments

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in IT, systems analysis, or application delivery
  • Hands-on experience in Salesforce Release Management
  • Strong understanding of business processes and how systems support them
  • Solid knowledge of Agile methodologies (Kanban preferred)
  • Experience working with SaaS applications and packaged software
  • Strong planning, estimation, and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA SD / OTC is a plus
  • Knowledge of PriceFx is a plus


Languages :

  • English B2


If you fulfill these requirements and are interested in this position, please send your resume along with your availability to start in this project, to the following e-mail address:

IT Recruiting Master

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Golang Developer - Relocation to Spain
description:
At CAPITOLE, we keep growing and want to do it with you!


We’re looking for passionate Backend Engineers with at least 3 years of experience in Golang to join our team and take part in a high-impact international project for a top-tier global brand. You’ll work in a modern, collaborative environment where innovation, performance, and scalability are at the heart of everything we build.


The position is fully remote, but you must be based in Spain, with willingness to relocate to Barcelona or Madrid. We take care of processing the highly qualified work permit.


What profile are we looking for?

  • University degree or, equivalently, 5 years of professional experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in backend development with Golang and a minimum of 2 years of experience in PHP/Symfony, Java/Kotlin or Python.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful API development.
  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • A high level of English is required since you will be working with international teams, and English is the working language.

title: Desenvolvedor React Native
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital

Código da oportunidade: 57426


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Desenvolvedor React Native


Responsabilidades Desenvolver e manter aplicações em React Native com foco em qualidade e testabilidade Criar, executar e manter testes unitários e testes integrados (imprescindível)

Atuar na automação de testes, garantindo confiabilidade e estabilidade das entregas Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, QAs e produto para evoluir a estratégia de testes

Apoiar na melhoria contínua de processos, padrões e boas práticas de qualidade


Requisitos (imprescindíveis)

Experiência como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a) React Native em nível profissional

Experiência sólida com testes unitários e testes integrados

Vivência com testes automatizados

Boa base em JavaScript / TypeScript

Mentalidade de qualidade desde o desenvolvimento


Diferenciais

Experiência prévia atuando em Chapter de QA

Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (ex: Jest, Testing Library, Cypress, Detox, etc.) Experiência com CI/CD e pipelines de testes

Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: Data Quality Analyst Senior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir, monitorar e otimizar processos de qualidade de dados.
  • Garantir a adoção das melhores práticas em qualidade de dados em todas as plataformas do cliente.
  • Liderar a equipe de qualidade de dados, orientando e capacitando os membros.
  • Criar e manter dashboards de qualidade de dados, monitorando KPIs em tempo real (completude, consistência, conformidade, integridade e unicidade).
  • Interagir com diferentes stakeholders, desde equipes técnicas até áreas de negócios, para garantir que os dados suportem decisões estratégicas e operacionais.
  • Implementar soluções eficazes para detecção e remediação de problemas de qualidade de dados.
  • Apoiar a evolução das estratégias de qualidade de dados da empresa, promovendo uma cultura baseada em dados confiáveis.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação Superior Completa em Análise de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Gestão de Tecnologia da Informação e/ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias de qualidade de dados (como DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Capacidade de analisar requisitos de negócio e traduzir necessidades em regras de qualidade de dados.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para interagir com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Perfil colaborativo, com mentalidade de resolução de problemas e inovação.
  • Experiência em definição e monitoramento de indicadores de qualidade de dados (completude, consistência, conformidade, unicidade e integridade).
  • Experiência em liderança técnica, mentoria e capacitação de times de dados.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão e qualidade de dados, governança de dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de qualidade de dados (Great Expectations, Informatica Data Quality, Talend, Collibra ou similares).
  • Experiência com SQL para análise e manipulação de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Data Visualization (Power BI) para criação de dashboards e relatórios sobre qualidade de dados.
  • Desejável conhecimento de serviços cloud e arquitetura de software (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud).



Diferenciais:

  • (Conhecimento e/ou experiência em metodologias ágeis (como SAFe).
  • Vivência em projetos de migração de dados e gestão de metadados.
  • Experiência com Data Observability e automação de monitoramento de qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning e DataOps aplicados à qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e estruturação de dicionários de dados.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de conformidade regulatória (como LGPD).
  • Noções de Python ou R para análise e manipulação avançada de dados.

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Talent Manager(Non Code)
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams.
  • Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed.
  • Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines.
  • Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations.
  • Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Mainframe Project  Manager
description:
Job Description: Mainframe Project Manager – Remote

Location: LATAM

Rate: DOE


Job Overview:

description:

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções para o setor de telecomunicações.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente da sustentação das integrações existentes e evolução de novos produtos.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-vendas e apresentações técnicas para clientes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (preferência para Java 11+).
  • Proficiência com Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Web, Security, Data).
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Familiaridade com API Gateways como Kong ou Apigee.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger ou ELK).


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas técnicas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos e atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para clientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas técnicos.
  • Visão sistêmica sobre o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end (React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Conhecimento de segurança de APIs e práticas de CQRs.
  • Experiência com PL/SQL e tuning de queries.

title: Estágio em Design
description:
Somos uma agência de comunicação integrada, investimos na mistura criativa de branding, design, comunicação institucional, audiovisual e marketing digital. Somos uma empresa especializada em criar e produzir histórias eficazes e autênticas. Conduzimos projetos de ponta-a-ponta. Do planejamento, criação até a execução de campanhas e conteúdos de alta performance.


Acreditamos em pessoas que são extremamente apaixonadas por comunicação, que possuem capacidade analítica e que pensam sob diferentes pontos de vistas. Pessoas que possuem energia alta, obstinadas, ágeis e que tem mindset de crescimento. Sempre com um olhar atento aos objetivos estratégicos dos negócios de cada indústria e marca com as quais somos parceiros criativos.


Atividades:

  • Criação de peças publicitárias para diferentes canais onlines e offlines.


Requisitos básicos:

  • Cursando Comunicação Social, Design, Marketing, Comunicação (Publicidade), Estudos de Mídia.
  • Elaboração de apresentações.
  • Organização.
  • Criatividade.
  • Heavy-user de redes sociais.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de edição de imagens (Photoshop, Illustrator, After effects).


Desejável:

  • Enviar portfólio.
  • Muita energia e match cultural com a Saving.

title: Anaplan Developer
description:
This a Remote full-time position in Brazil working with US clients.


We offer:

  • 100% Remote Work
  • Salary R$14,000 gross monthly
  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação R$ 992,00
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco ( Descontos Sujeito a Alteração)
  • Plano Odontológico Bradesco
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche


Title: Anaplan Developer

The Role of the Board Developer is to understand the requirements of the specific regions related to the Price Management Tool and Sales Planning & Forecasting applications. Based on that the Board Developer implements and enhances solutions within these applications. The Board Developer also supports in Maintenance and Support of the existing solutions.


Required Qualifications:

  • Review and understand client requirements as defined during Board scoping and analysis phases.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions through implementations and enhancements within the Board platform.
  • Design and implement Board capsules, procedures, and data models that align with business logic and performance expectations.
  • Optimize existing functionalities and incorporate new features to improve solution efficiency and user experience.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and Data Engineers to ensure seamless integration between data sources, models, and user-facing applications.
  • Support solution testing in conjunction with the Tester role, ensuring configurations meet functional and technical specifications.
  • Provide UAT support and assist with deployment activities to ensure smooth transition to production.
  • Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager, Business Partner, and team.
  • Stay current with Board platform updates and best practices, applying new features and enhancements to improve solution quality.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções para o setor de telecomunicações.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar ativamente da sustentação das integrações existentes e evolução de novos produtos.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Apoiar processos de pré-vendas e apresentações técnicas para clientes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Java (preferência para Java 11+).
  • Proficiência com Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring (Web, Security, Data).
  • Experiência com integrações via APIs REST, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ) e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Vivência com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Familiaridade com API Gateways como Kong ou Apigee.
  • Experiência com observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger ou ELK).


Competências Comportamentais:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas técnicas.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos e atuar em um ambiente de alta complexidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para clientes.
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas técnicos.
  • Visão sistêmica sobre o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end (React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Conhecimento de segurança de APIs e práticas de CQRs.
  • Experiência com PL/SQL e tuning de queries.


Você vai amar trabalhar aqui se:

  • Quiser ter a possibilidade de aprender e trabalhar com diversas tecnologias;
  • Estiver em busca de uma empresa com possibilidades reais de crescimento e carreira;
  • Estiver em busca de um ambiente leve e descontraído para trabalhar;


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);


E mais: Trabalho Híbrido.

  • Apoio a certificações;
  • Day off no mês do seu aniversário;

#VemPraENG!
